dedupe_keys.name: sdmx statistical data and metadata exchange standard

description: SDMx (Statistical Data and Metadata eXchange), formerly written SDMX, is the international standard for exchanging and publishing statistical data and metadata in formats that are both human- and machine-friendly, supporting sending and receiving data for reporting and giving standard interfaces, structured formats and rich metadata. The site offers the standards, guidelines such as version 1.2 of the guidelines for the CL_ORGANISATION code list, implementations, tools and learning resources, and announced version 2.2 of the Validation and Transformation Language (VTL) in August 2026, with public review until 31 October 2026, and the 13th SDMx Experts Workshop in Ankara from 30 November to 4 December 2026. It is maintained by the SDMx sponsors, who announced the renaming from SDMX, and its user community. Coverage is global, used by statistical agencies and central banks. The standards are available free online. Caveats: SDMx is a format, and each agency's data structure definitions must be read to use its data. For simulation it is the API format through which central bank and statistical data, such as ECB, IMF and BIS series, can be pulled automatically into financial resilience models. It is related to the IMF SDMX Central and ECB Data Portal records in this catalogue.
